decisions: C711: two CSharp bounded-dictionary layout entry points previously multiply Int32 entries by8 before division, rejecting a valid numerator boundary even when final bucket/storage sizes fit their existing Int32 fields. Widen only the ratio numerator, divide, then keep checked Int32 conversion and all checked final arithmetic.

C711: SLG foundation.boundedDictionaryLayout already performs Int/Int64 numerator arithmetic and needs no admission weakening or code change. Allocation-free type declarations and actual small main programs confirm repaired CSharp behavior first.
C710: CSharp named readonly reference values are loaded and materialized as RuntimeInlineSlice before EmitSocketSendVectored obtains pointer/length and element field layout.

C710: SLG opcode-299 indexes element metadata from a reference instead of canonical slice and extracts pointer fields from raw ptr %arg1. Generic reference emission already produced the slice SSA; reuse existing canonical receiver type/value writers and referenced type for element lookup. Preserve ordinary slice and exact element ABI offsets.
Keep receiveVectored mut-storage ABI and untested reference forms separate; no large storage instance or nonlocal network request.
